description:
src/ocsp.rs:36, src/async_ocsp.rs:22, src/cache.rs:785: `const OCSP_REQUEST_CT: &str = "application/ocsp-request";` (or inline string literal) is declared in three places. The constant is also exposed via OcspRequestBytes::content_type — that field literally exists for callers to use this value without redeclaring it.

Rewrite: in the three call sites (sync ocsp.rs, async ocsp.rs, cache.rs cached fetcher), use `req_bytes.content_type` from the OcspRequestBytes already in scope:

    let req = FetchRequest::post(url, &req_bytes.body, req_bytes.content_type);

Drops three near-identical OCSP_REQUEST_CT consts. The OcspRequestBytes::content_type field is documented as 'Always application/ocsp-request' — using it via the struct centralises the value at its definition site (ocsp_request.rs:115).
title: FetchMethod::Post body+content_type duplicated in OCSP_REQUEST_CT constant across modules
